subject.title: [Bug]: Codex model catalog returns codex/* while canonical config and execution use openai/*

question: Should Codex-discovered models use canonical `openai/*` references with first-class runtime metadata, or should `codex/*` become a permanently supported provider route?
rationale: The shipped catalog and migration contracts conflict, and the current generic catalog schema cannot represent both canonical provider identity and Codex harness selection; this choice affects persisted identifiers, plugin APIs, and client behavior.

options.title: Canonical ref plus runtime
options.body: Add or reuse typed runtime metadata so catalogs expose `openai/*` while explicitly selecting the Codex harness.

options.title: Permanent Codex provider
options.body: Keep `codex/*` as a separate supported provider and revise migration policy, docs, and execution contracts to match.

recommendation.title: Canonical ref plus runtime
recommendation.body: Add or reuse typed runtime metadata so catalogs expose `openai/*` while explicitly selecting the Codex harness.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the broadest available history across the provider, migration, and catalog-alias surfaces affected by the contract choice.
